how_to_play.title: How to play?
how_to_play.game_settings_desc: In the settings menu you can set the parameters of the playing field: the number of rows, columns and mines, and also change the language
how_to_play.gameplay_desc: The game starts with the first safe move - it is guaranteed not to lead to an explosion.
how_to_play.system_desc: The numbers in the cells indicate the number of mines in the adjacent cells.
how_to_play.controls_desc_1: Left mouse button (or simple touch) - opens a cell
how_to_play.controls_desc_2: Right mouse button (or long tap) - Places a flag on a suspected mine
how_to_play.additional_functions_button_: Help button - automatically opens a safe cell with a mine (if it is not already open and marked with a flag)
The defusal kit activates a special mode. When opened, the mine does not explode. Instead, a window appears asking you to select a defusal wire. The success rate is 50%.
how_to_play.good_luck: We wish you an exciting game and good luck in finding mines!
